specs.goal: The model recorded for a task (report, ledger, events) is the model that actually answered the final turn.
specs.why: Measurement and re-optimization rely on it; today the first rung is recorded after a climb (POLL-RUNTIME).
acceptance: after a climb from rung A to B the report, ledger and events all name B
a regression test fails if the recorded model differs from the answering one
constraints: spec only: Dev/Ops decide method and plan

specs.goal: The router can choose a cheaper starting rung again when cheaper rungs keep winning.
specs.why: Re-optimization needs a way down; today the ledger only climbs.
acceptance: given recent wins on a cheaper rung the next task starts there
never below the lowest or above the highest rung of the ladder
constraints: spec only: Dev/Ops decide method and plan

specs.goal: A reproducible reference environment in which the full ga-sdk suite is green (rlo included).
specs.why: 62 tests fail only for environment reasons; guard tests need a green base.
acceptance: one documented recipe builds the environment from nothing
full suite: 0 failures, 0 errors in that environment
the recipe is used by every verdict
constraints: spec only: Dev/Ops decide method and plan

why: R0 specs are independent: run all three in parallel. Order = priority if capacity is short: R0c first (green reference base gates every later verdict and lets Ops list the 62 env failures per test), then R0a (recorded model feeds R1 ledger), then R0b. Ops R0 baseline: ops/flow/measure/R0.json (today ~10.2 USD/wall-hour; hubs 6.08 USD/h, workers 4.57, integrators 1.15; shadow gate 0/10, 0/25 agree — every shadow decision ASK_HUMAN). Report each as release/1 to Ops; Ops verifies against the acceptance lists.
